'''Revenant Flesh''' is obtained by killing the [[Revenant Horror]]. It is a {{Odds|guaranteed}} drop, and is used to make items like [[Revenant Viscera]], which is used to make many high level items.

== Obtaining ==
=== Revenant Horror ===
'''Revenant Flesh''' is a {{O|G}} drop from any tier of [[Revenant Horror]].
;Amounts
* {{SlayerTier|I}}: 1-3x
* {{SlayerTier|II}}: 9-18x
* {{SlayerTier|III}}: 30-50x
* {{SlayerTier|IV}}: 50-64x
* {{SlayerTier|V}}: 63-64x
